title: Cover copied linked-worktree gitfiles and missing commondir in approval-boundary tests
outcome: Cross-platform approval-delivery tests reject a copied valid linked-worktree gitfile whose backpointer targets another worktree, and a Git admin directory with gitdir but no commondir.
acceptance: A behavioural test copies a valid linked-worktree .git file into a different reviewed directory and verifies that both acceptance decisions remain refused with the existing message and no runtime delivery.
A behavioural test verifies that an admin directory containing a gitdir backpointer but no commondir does not exempt an ancestor approval.
